title: Brask the Mole
html:
Brask the Mole is a named Brigand seen at level 18.

Wearing

head Feathered Cap Greentorso Silver Torsoarms Iron Armslegs Silver Legsfeet Iron Feetmain hand Silver Dagger

Where to find Brask the Mole

  • Inside Bandit Hole · seen 2×

What it can drop

  • Mole's Pick (unique Silver Dagger): 2% of kills (1 in 50), 10% from an elite (1 in 10). +30% damage against a target at full hitpoints.
  • Gear every kill: a piece from its tier, excellent or better, and a second piece 1 kill in 5.
  • Gold worth about 5 ordinary kills.
  • Enchanted: 1 kill in 100 enchants a piece (up to 9c, and only what its material can hold).
  • Elite: a boss spawns elite 1 time in 100, and an elite makes its unique 5 times as likely.

From the game’s rules and its own guide. See Unique items.
